We applied template 61428 to molecule SMILES "C[Si](C)(C)C[O]C1CCCCC1". The result is '()' meaning empty list? It returned empty parentheses, likely no precursors. Maybe the SMILES is not correct? The template expects an alcohol protected as TMS ether. The product SMILES should be TMS ether of cyclohexanol? The given product in mapped_rxn is [CH3:1][Si:2]([CH3:3])([CH3:4])[O:5][CH:6]1[CH2:7][CH2:8][CH2:9][CH2:10][CH2:11]1 which is TMS-oxygen attached to cyclohexyl. That SMILES is "C[Si](C)(C)C[O]C1CCCCC1". That's what we used. The template didn't apply? Maybe need to deprotect? Actually the template is retrosynthetic: break O-Si bond to give alcohol and TMSOTf? The precursors likely are the alcohol (cyclohexanol) and TMSOTf (or TMSCl?). The template likely yields two precursors: the alcohol and the silyl donor (maybe [CH3]Si(CH3)3? Actually TMSOTf is "C[Si](C)(C)OS(=O)(=O)C". But the template may produce the alcohol and "C[Si](C)(C)N[Si](C)(C)C"? The mapped_rxn includes other reagents: .[CH3:1][Si:2]([CH3:3])([CH3:4])N[Si](C)(C)C .O=C1NS(=O)(=O)C2=CC=CC=C12.N . So the template includes TMSOTf (maybe as [CH3]Si(CH3)3N[Si](C)(C)C?) plus a sulfonamide? Not sure.

But we have previous input from make_5_lvl2-apply_template-3 gave precursors [['CC=O', 'CCO']]. That's unrelated.

We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template from make_5_lvl2-template_search-4 to the molecule. The tool returned empty, meaning no precursors? Could be that the template expects a different representation (maybe need to include explicit hydrogen on O?). The SMILES maybe should be "C[Si](C)(C)C[O]C1CCCCC1". That's what we used.

Maybe need to use check_smiles_reaction_template_matching to see if template matches.
